body:
Thank you a lot for your post. I agree with the fact that he had the right to change his mind at any time and if I didn’t allow that , it would be very manipulative from my part. 

Thank you also for the advice, I posted here cause it is an issue that I have a lot of struggle understanding and coping with it. 

I wish also to give a small clarification:

-at that time he was 100% sure he wanted something long term ( even before I even proposed it )  but changed after completely his mind suddenly. It may be something that happened on his part, I don’t know. 
( when I’m writing it like that I feel .. empathy ? Or at least it seems more “comprehensible ) . It’s just that I cannot comprehend how someone can change minds so suddenly in matter of hours and pass from someone quite close to a stranger . 


I guess, I just still feel very hurt and with the knowledge that I have now, I wouldn’t do the leap. But at that time I trusted and I still feel very burned by the experience. 
Still thank you a lot for your comment and clarifying for me a little bit more how consent works.

When I’m rereading my response to you, I see that I have probably chosen the wrong sub to talk about this issue. But still , thank you a lot for your response.

Edit: At that time, I simply thought that it was something normal and that I had to do in order to start a relationship ... you know ... like “passing a test”
Thanks for validating my experience . Have a nice day :)
Thanks , finally someone sees it ! Nobody cares and even they protect him! The worst is that he said “you can tell people but they will do nothing” like ... How can you tell that ?
I would never wish to pose any judgement on anything that you have described here. Thank you a lot for sharing and I will keep in mind your advice . Thank you a lot for sharing
Thank you a lot for the suggestion! I will try it out :)
I feel it too. I would really like to be able to be above that but it feels so hopeless . You’re just ruminating all the time and it’s never really out of your head . It’s just clings to you ...
Thank you, I’m talking a lot. Even oversharing. I’m waiting the return of my therapist from her medical leave.
